validationResults.name: No local template storage directory created

expected.message: Local template storage directories should NOT exist

validationResults.difference: Directory exists with 18 template files. These are legacy files from before the architectural migration.

remediation.reason: Per architectural specification, templates must ONLY be stored in backend (SurrealDB) and retrieved via MCP. Local storage violates the backend-as-single-source-of-truth constraint.
remediation.notes: These templates should already exist in the backend. Deleting local copies will force all future retrievals to go through MCP.
